Aladdin Magic Racer.name: Aladdin Magic Racer
Aladdin Magic Racer.summary: Have you ever dreamed of flying a magic carpet through wild race tracks in the midst of scenery inspired by the most beautiful places in the universe? Then it's time to take the controls!

Diva Girls - Divas on Ice.name: Diva Girls: Divas on Ice
Diva Girls - Divas on Ice.summary: Meet the Diva Girls for the first time on Nintendo Wii. Everyone's got their favorite but who will be yours? Kelly, Gabrielle, Alyssa and Madison are four young girls skating for glory in the Miracle Ice Festival. Dress your favorite Diva Girl in thousands of combinations of customizable outfits then train hard to upgrade your skating skills so you can woo the crowd, impress the judges and be crowned Princess on Ice.

G.I. Joe - The Rise of Cobra.name: G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra
G.I. Joe - The Rise of Cobra.summary: After the events of the film, Duke and Scarlett travels to the Arctic and free Heavy Duty, Ripcord and Snake Eyes from the M.A.R.S Detention Center. Also, they fight the Baroness and bring her to the Pit. In Egypt, the Joes learn that Cobra is taking the Apep (Gem), and must defeat Firefly. In the jungle, the Joes learn that Cobra is making a pyramid-like building in the middle of the jungle. From there, the Joes must defeat James McCullen (who now takes the identity of Destro) at the rooftop of the pyramid building. Finally, they must defeat the Cobra Commander and Storm Shadow at North Magnetic Pole Volcano base.

Hardy Boys, The - The Hidden Theft.name: The Hardy Boys: The Hidden Theft
Hardy Boys, The - The Hidden Theft.summary: The Hardy Boys: The Hidden Theft is a point-and-click adventure, based on the book "The Tower Treasure".

Titeuf - Le Film.summary: Titeuf le Film on Wii is a compilation of mini-games intended for young players. Help Titeuf escape a surprise interrogation or survive a chase against his lifelong enemies.
